detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Dead by Daylight’s The Walking Dead includes 2 new Survivors, Rick Grimes and Michonne. Purchasing this add-on unlocks an exclusive Sheriff's Hat badge and Tank in Ruins banner.

RICK GRIMES

Having experienced life in a horrific world, Rick Grimes is no stranger to violence and horror. Yet despite his countless brushes with death, many of which pushed him beyond his limits, his mercy still prevails over his wrath.  Rick Grimes comes with 3 new perks.

Apocalyptic Ingenuity

After unlocking and rummaging through a number of Chests, gain the ability to create a Fragile Pallet in place of a Broken Pallet.  

 

Come and Get Me!

After Unhooking a Survivor, while crouched and idle you may use an Ability to make all nearby injured and dying Survivors completely silent and hide their Pools of Blood. In exchange, you’ll scream and briefly reveal your Aura to the Killer. 

 

Teamwork: Toughen Up

When another nearby Survivor Pallet stuns or blinds the Killer while you’re injured, your Grunts of Pain, Scratch Marks, and Pools of Blood will be completely reduced for a duration.  

MICHONNE GRIMES

As steady as the hand that wields the sword, Michonne represents the quintessential survivor. No matter what lies in her path, her conviction never wavers – even when the odds appear insurmountable. 

Michonne comes with 3 new perks.

Conviction

Conviction activates after healing a Survivor. While in the Dying State with recovery progress underway, gain the ability to instantly recover. You will become Broken and return to the Dying State after a duration. 

 

Last Stand

After spending time in the Killer’s Terror Radius outside of a chase, Fast-Vault while near the Killer to stun them for a duration. Then, this perk is disabled for the rest of the trial.

Teamwork: Throw Down

Successfully pallet stun a Killer to give nearby injured Survivors Endurance for a duration, revealing the Killer’s Aura to them.

EXCLUSIVE CHAPTER ITEMS: SHERIFF'S HAT BADGE AND TANK IN RUINS BANNER

The Walking Dead Chapter includes an exclusive Sheriff's Hat badge and Tank in Ruins banner, only available as part of the DLC. Please note that these items cannot be purchased separately.

 

Together, we endure. Alone, we fall.
